This item represents the carrying amount on the entity's balance sheet of its investments in common stock of equity method investees. This item includes assets held under deferred compensation agreements and the carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of amounts which could be received based on the terms of the insurance contract upon surrendering life policies owned by the entity.
